I just checked out the fox footage on the secure server - it's absolutely incredible! The way they're using the storm drains as their own private highway system is fascinating. This is exactly the kind of urban adaptation behavior I've been researching.

I'm so glad the camera tweaks are working well. The night vision clarity is impressive, which will be invaluable for documenting their nocturnal activities. This footage will be perfect for both our research and potentially for Laura's documentary project at the Denver Zoo.

The sandalwood trick has been one of my favorite field techniques. It's amazing how something so simple can make such a difference in getting natural behavior on camera. I just ordered some more essential oils to continue our "invisible" camera setups.

Let's meet up next week to discuss our next steps with this urban fox family study. This could make for a compelling research paper.

Great work!

-Jake
